operations.name: interp_eval
operations.description: Evaluate, differentiate or integrate an interpolant (scipy.interpolate): linear, cubic spline, PCHIP (monotone), Akima, modified Akima, smoothing spline or n-D radial basis functions. Nodes must be finite and strictly increasing (NOT_INCREASING / DUPLICATE_X before any work); outside the node range the extrapolate policy decides (BAD_RANGE by default). Statuses OK, SINGULAR / ILL_CONDITIONED (rbf), NUMERICAL_FAILURE, TIME_LIMIT. Result: values, n_extrapolated, integral, interpolation_error (rbf). Inline results hold at most ~900 numbers; use the _to form for more.

params.name: kind
params.description: Interpolant. linear/cubic/pchip/akima/makima need >= 2 nodes, smoothing >= 5, rbf at most 5000 nodes in at most 8 dimensions. PCHIP preserves monotonicity and local bounds; Akima, Makima and cubic can overshoot, including monotone step-like data.

params.name: x
params.description: Nodes: a strictly increasing vector (kinds other than rbf) or, for rbf, a matrix with one row per node. Finite; inline <=1000 numbers or .npy / .safetensors#key.

params.name: y
params.description: Finite values at the nodes: a vector with one value per node.

params.name: x_new
params.description: Evaluation points: a vector (a matrix with the node dimension for rbf). Read form: give x_new, integrate or both. Write form requires x_new. Read form: at most ~900 points.

params.name: bc_type
params.description: cubic only. Boundary condition (default not-a-knot): natural sets the second derivative to 0 at the ends, clamped the first derivative to 0, periodic needs y[0] == y[-1].

params.name: lam
params.description: smoothing only. Penalty weight >= 0; 0 interpolates (natural cubic spline), a large value tends to the least-squares line. Omitted: chosen by generalised cross-validation.

params.name: kernel
params.description: rbf only. Radial basis function (default thin_plate_spline). thin_plate_spline, cubic and quintic reproduce low-degree polynomials exactly.

params.name: epsilon
params.description: rbf only. Shape parameter > 0 (default 1) used by multiquadric, inverse_multiquadric, inverse_quadratic and gaussian.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: rbf only. Ridge term >= 0 (default 0 = interpolate the nodes).

params.name: degree
params.description: rbf only. Degree of the polynomial term, -1..3 (default: the kernel's minimum). -1 disables the polynomial; otherwise at least the kernel minimum with enough nodes for every polynomial term.

params.name: nu
params.description: Derivative order: 0..3 (linear: 0..1; rbf: 0). At knots a piecewise function takes its right-hand value.

params.name: integrate
params.description: [a, b] with a < b: the definite integral of the interpolant (not for rbf). Bounds must lie in the node range unless extrapolate is extend.

params.name: extrapolate
params.description: Points outside the nodes: error (BAD_RANGE, the default), nan (NaN values, counted in n_extrapolated) or extend (the end polynomial; for rbf the bounding box of the nodes is the 'range').

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

params.name: family
params.description: Prototype. cheby1 needs rp, cheby2 rs, ellip both.

params.name: order
params.description: Prototype order 1..20 (band filters have 2*order poles).

params.name: btype
params.description: Band type.

params.name: wn
params.description: Critical frequency: a number, or [low, high] for bandpass/bandstop. In Hz when fs is given, else as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency (0..1). Strictly inside (0, Nyquist). params.name: fs
params.description: Sampling frequency > 0; omit for normalised frequencies (1 = Nyquist).

params.name: rp
params.description: Passband ripple in dB, (0, 100]; cheby1 and ellip only.

params.name: rs
params.description: Stopband attenuation in dB, (0, 200]; cheby2 and ellip only.

params.name: freqs
params.description: Frequencies (<=200, in the units of wn) at which to report magnitude and phase (radians) of the filter response.

params.name: x
params.description: Finite signal to filter (vector). Required by the write form.

params.name: mode
params.description: With x. sosfilt is causal (phase lag, zero initial state); sosfiltfilt (default) runs forward and backward: zero phase, squared magnitude, needs more than 3*(2*sections+1) samples.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

operations.name: sig_spectrum
operations.description: Spectral estimates with scipy.signal: Welch / periodogram power spectral density (or spectrum), cross-spectral density and magnitude-squared coherence. One-sided, real signals; inline <=1000 numbers per input or bounded file refs. Reports f and the estimate, n_segments and df. Only Welch/periodogram return peak_freq, enbw and total_power: sum(density)*df or sum(spectrum)*df/ENBW, invariant under zero padding. Statuses OK, NUMERICAL_FAILURE. Inline results hold at most ~900 numbers; use the _to form for more.

params.name: method
params.description: welch averages windowed segments; periodogram is one window over the whole signal; csd needs y and returns pxy_re / pxy_im; coherence needs y and returns cxy in [0, 1].

params.name: x
params.description: Finite real signal (vector), at least 4 samples.

params.name: y
params.description: Second signal of the same length (csd and coherence only).

params.name: fs
params.description: Sampling frequency > 0 (default 1).

params.name: window
params.description: Window (default hann; boxcar for periodogram).

params.name: nperseg
params.description: Segment length, 2..min(signal length, 65536) (default min(256, length), coherence min(256, length/2)). Coherence requires at least two segments; scaled copies yield one only where power is defined. Not for periodogram.

params.name: noverlap
params.description: Overlap between segments, 0..nperseg-1 (default nperseg/2). Not for periodogram.

params.name: nfft
params.description: FFT length (zero padding), >= nperseg (>= the signal length for periodogram), at most 131072.

params.name: detrend
params.description: Per-segment detrending.

params.name: scaling
params.description: density (default): power per Hz; spectrum: power per bin (an on-bin sine of amplitude A peaks at A^2/2). Not for coherence.

params.name: average
params.description: Segment averaging, welch and csd only (default mean).

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

operations.name: sig_peaks
operations.description: Inputs inline <=1000 numbers or bounded file refs. Local maxima of a finite signal (scipy.signal.find_peaks) with heights, prominences and widths at rel_height. Plateaus report their middle sample; the first and last sample are never peaks. Result: n_peaks, indices, heights, prominences, widths (read form: at most ~225 peaks). Use the _to form for more peaks.

params.name: x
params.description: Finite signal (vector), at least 3 samples.

params.name: height
params.description: Minimum height: a number or [min, max] (null for an open end).

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum vertical distance to both neighbours: a number or [min, max], >= 0.

params.name: distance
params.description: Minimum horizontal distance between peaks in samples, >= 1; smaller peaks are removed first.

params.name: prominence
params.description: Required prominence: a number or [min, max], >= 0.

params.name: width
params.description: Required width at rel_height: a number or [min, max] in samples, >= 0.

params.name: wlen
params.description: Window length in samples (>= 3), rounded up to odd. Candidates times effective window must be <=20M; otherwise supply a smaller explicit wlen. Read candidate count <=225 before prominence work.

params.name: rel_height
params.description: Height fraction of the prominence at which widths are measured, in (0, 1] (0.5 = half prominence, FWHM only for isolated zero-baseline peaks). Widths linearly interpolate sampled crossings.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

operations.name: spatial_knn
operations.description: Exact nearest neighbours: scaled cKDTree for p<=2 or infinity; stable brute-force for other p (n*m*d<=20M). Unsafe floating-point ranges return NUMERICAL_FAILURE. The write form requires 2*m*(k+exclude_self)<=1900000 before spawn. k-nearest: indices and distances (rows sorted by distance; the index order of equal distances is implementation-defined, compare distances). Radius: counts per query plus flat indices and distances (CSR layout, sorted by distance within a query). Status OK. Inline results hold at most ~900 numbers; use the _to form for more.

params.name: points
params.description: Finite n x d matrix (a vector is one-dimensional), d <= 32.

params.name: queries
params.description: Finite m x d query matrix; omit to query the points themselves (a point is then its own nearest neighbour unless exclude_self).

params.name: k
params.description: Number of neighbours, 1..1000 and <= n. Exactly one of k and radius.

params.name: radius
params.description: Return every neighbour within this distance (inclusive), > 0. Exactly one of k and radius.

params.name: p
params.description: Minkowski norm: a number in [1, 64] (1 Manhattan, 2 Euclidean) or "inf" (Chebyshev). Default 2.

params.name: exclude_self
params.description: Only without queries: drop each point from its own neighbour list.

params.name: max_pairs
params.description: Radius mode: refuse (OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE) when more than this many neighbour pairs would result, 1..1000000.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

operations.name: spatial_hull
operations.description: Convex hull, Delaunay triangulation or Voronoi diagram with QHull (scipy.spatial). The QHull options are fixed per kind and never caller-supplied. Degenerate input (collinear/coplanar points, fewer than dim+1 points, duplicates only, a QHull error) is a domain status DEGENERATE with a message, not an error. Statuses OK, DEGENERATE, NUMERICAL_FAILURE, TIME_LIMIT. convex_hull: vertices, simplices, volume, area (in 2-D: area and perimeter); delaunay: simplices, volume, n_coplanar; voronoi: vertices, point_region, regions and ridge_vertices as flat arrays with offsets (-1 is the point at infinity), ridge_points. Inline results hold at most ~900 numbers; use the _to form for more.

params.name: points
params.description: Finite n x d matrix, 2 <= d <= 6. Point caps shrink with d (convex_hull: 20000/20000/800/400/100 for d=2..6; delaunay and voronoi: 20000/800/300/100/50).

params.name: kind
params.description: Which QHull structure to compute.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

operations.name: spatial_dist
operations.description: Pairwise distance matrix (scipy.spatial.distance.cdist) between the rows of a and b (b omitted: a with itself, a symmetric matrix). Metrics come from a closed list. A pair for which the metric is undefined (cosine/correlation of a zero or constant vector, an indefinite VI, overflow) makes the status UNDEFINED with a count and bounded offending row indices, and no matrix is returned. Statuses OK, UNDEFINED, TIME_LIMIT. Result: shape, distances (n x m). Inline results hold at most ~900 numbers; use the _to form for more.

params.name: a
params.description: Finite n x d matrix.

params.name: b
params.description: Finite m x d matrix; omit to compare a with itself. n*m is limited to 1,000,000.

params.name: metric
params.description: Distance. jaccard treats non-zero as true; hamming is the fraction of differing coordinates; mahalanobis needs vi.

params.name: vi
params.description: mahalanobis only: the d x d inverse covariance matrix, symmetric within 1e-12*max(abs(VI)); accepted roundoff is symmetrized and vi_symmetrised is reported.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: Cooperative compute wall budget >0..30 seconds (default 10); independent hard child cap PYCLI_TIMEOUT_S <=50 seconds includes imports. Native calls also have pre-spawn work/output caps.

params.name: preprocess
params.description: Required exact object {scale:boolean, one_hot:[unique feature names]}; no defaults or extra keys. Sorted full one-hot encoding then optional training mean/population-variance scaling; <=64 encoded features; unseen levels rejected.

params.name: seed
params.description: uint32 [0,4294967295], required for stochastic families (linear_svc/kmeans/trees) and every CV; optional for deterministic lbfgs logistic and other families. MT19937 echoed only when randomness is used.

params.name: cv
params.description: kfold/stratified/group/timeseries; supervised families only; preprocessing learned independently per fold. Stratified requires classification; timeseries cannot shuffle.

params.name: n_splits
params.description: Integer 2..20, <= rows; default 5; group CV also needs at least n_splits distinct groups.

params.name: shuffle
params.description: Default false; shuffle kfold/stratified/group with required seed; forbidden for timeseries.

params.name: groups
params.description: Required group column for group CV; forbidden for other CV kinds; group identities never overlap train/test.

params.name: metrics
params.description: Required unique metric names (1..4): regressors mse/mae/r2; classifiers accuracy/f1_macro/binary roc_auc/log_loss. Probability metrics unavailable for linear_svc; undefined folds return non-OK with diagnostics.

params.name: time_limit
params.description: ML computation wall budget >0..30 seconds, default 10; imports excluded; Python signal boundaries plus hard child timeout and pre-spawn work caps.
